# Tandapp

> Tandapp is a free, private group savings (tanda, cundina, susú, ROSCA) coordination app available on iOS and Android.

Tandapp simplifies rotating group savings by replacing messy spreadsheets, confusing WhatsApp threads, and unrecorded payments with a shared, transparent record of turns, contributions, and payment receipts.

## Critical Notice
Tandapp does **not** hold, collect, or process money. Members make payments directly to one another using their preferred payment methods (cash, bank transfer, etc.). Tandapp serves solely as a coordination, scheduling, and verifiable record-keeping platform.

## Key Features
- **Online Tanda Creation**: Set the contribution amount, frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly), number of members, and invite participants via an invitation link or code.
- **Round & Turn Tracking**: Clear schedule displaying who receives the pot for each round, due dates, and past rounds.
- **Color-Coded Payment Status**: Instant visibility into who has paid (green), who is pending (gray), and who is late (red).
- **Payment Proof & Receipts**: Members can upload transfer screenshots or receipts directly to payments and tanda group chat for dispute-free verification.
- **Group Chat**: In-app private group messaging for coordination and reminders.
- **Private Savings Tracker**: Individual private goal tracker alongside group tandas, visible only to the individual user.
- **No Ads & 100% Free**: No subscription fees, no credit checks, no transaction fees.

## Supported Languages
- English (`https://tandapp.net/en`)
- Spanish / Español (`https://tandapp.net/es`)
